heading.title: Secure Electronic Records and Secure Electronic Signature1

article.title: Secure electronic record.
article.content: Where any security procedure has been applied to an electronic record at a specific point of time, then such record shall be deemed to be a secure electronic record from such point of time to the time of verification.
article.html:
14Secure electronic record.

Section 14 · Chapter V · page 12 of the Act

Where any security procedure has been applied to an electronic record at a specific point of time, then such record shall be deemed to be a secure electronic record from such point of time to the time of verification.
